what: Every BLS news release scheduled at 08:30 AM Eastern in 2026, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics' own 2026 schedule page, parsed as the 2009-2025 pages were; the day-level file lists each date once with its releases.
parser: scripts/parse_bls_schedule_2026.py (html.parser over <table class='release-list'>; rows whose first cell is a date and whose time cell starts with '08:30'; scripts/parse_bls_schedule.py's reader)

page.obtained: saved by hand from the operator's browser on 2026-10-13 as a complete web page ('Schedule of Selected Releases 2026.html'; the HTML file kept, its _files folder not) -- BLS refused automated requests that day: 403 to a scripted fetch, Access Denied to headless Edge

use: FV3-C's confirmation kits (D-355): on these dates the session's fair price is the open of the 8:30 ET candle; added to the kits' embedded table after the cores (fv3_kit.confirm_preamble); not a firm rule, so verified here by source and hash, and checked by the data-integrity agent before any kit is generated.
